name: Empirical source-sink routing
mechanism_en: Benchmarked funds cannot go to cash; selling a source node forces buying the sink node from the measured Flow-Routing Matrix. Condition sink entries on source outflow where the pair is a placebo-surviving routing cell.
mechanism_zh: 基准基金不能转为现金；卖出源节点迫使从已测量流向矩阵买入汇节点。以源节点流出为条件触发汇节点入场信号。

name: Cascade breadth conviction multiplier
mechanism_en: When N>=3 same-complex subsector OUT onsets occur within K=15 sessions, the breadth of exit is a conviction multiplier for the sink node. The June rotation showed this cascade pattern (foundries->compute->litho->memory).
mechanism_zh: 当同一复合体中N>=3个子板块在15个交易日内出现流出启动时，退出的广度是汇节点的信念乘数。

name: Cohesion collapse-rebuild turn
mechanism_en: Cohesion falls through the washout (idiosyncratic selling), then jumps on the turn (coordinated buying = institutional re-entry). Compound: washout_w flag active AND cohesion_chg > 0.056 (the one FDR-surviving group_flow validated threshold).
mechanism_zh: 凝聚力在洗盘过程中下降（个股抛售），然后在转折点跃升（协调买入=机构重新入场）。复合条件：洗盘标志激活且凝聚力变化>0.056。

name: Rate-proxy washout with vol-subsiding conditioner
mechanism_en: Rate-proxy sector washouts are buyable only when bond vol (TLT realized vol) is subsiding. Vol-subsiding approximated as tlt_ret_10d rolling-std over 20d crossed_below its own 60d mean. The defensive rotation rates confound weaponized as a conditioner.
mechanism_zh: 利率代理板块的洗盘信号仅在债券波动率（TLT实际波动率）下降时可交易。波动率下降近似为tlt_ret_10d的20日滚动标准差跌破其60日均值。
